regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood leads at 33" total, with its biggest day Wednesday at 15". The NWS is calling for more, 45 to 74 inches Sunday night through Thursday night. A Winter Weather Advisory runs from Sunday to Monday night. Sugar Bowl and Palisades are close behind.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth totals 26", with 14" on Wednesday. Strong southwest wind with gusts to 60 mph is expected Wednesday night and Thursday. The NWS is calling for more, 36 to 54 inches Monday through Thursday night.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbasin leads at 14", with 8" on Tuesday. Expect a mix of rain and snow early in the week, then mostly light snow. Powder Mountain and Alta are similar, and Alta also gets 6" on Tuesday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee leads at 10", with 6" on Tuesday, and snow showers continue through the week. Big Sky totals 7", with 6" on Tuesday. Sun Valley gets 6" over the period, with 3" on Tuesday.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat totals 7", with 6" on Friday. Telluride gets 7", with 4" on Tuesday, and expect a slight chance of thunderstorms Friday. Crested Butte adds 6" across Tuesday and Friday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek leads at 10", with 6" on Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more, 17 to 30 inches Tuesday through Friday night. Expect strong southwest wind, gusting to 55 mph, Thursday night through Friday.
